verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single Microsoft support article title, "Install Quick Assist", which points to Windows' first-party remote assistance tool for sharing a screen with, or controlling, another PC. The pack does not describe what it does or how it works, and nothing documents Remote Desktop for accessing remote sessions. Missing for 10: any description of Quick Assist's screen sharing or remote control, documentation of Remote Desktop host/client access to a remote session, edition requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
